s: A company is storing data in several Amazon DynamoDB tables. A solutions architect must use a serverless architecture to make the data accessible publicly through a simple API over HTTPS. The solution must scale automatically in response to demand. Which solutions meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
o: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure this API with direct integrations to DynamoDB by using API Gateway's AWS integration type.
Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API. Configure this API with direct integrations to Dynamo DB by using API Gateway's AWS integration type.
Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API. Configure this API with integrations to AWS Lambda functions that return data from the DynamoDB tables.
Create an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Configure this accelerator with AWS Lambda@Edge function integrations that return data from the DynamoDB tables.
Create a Network Load Balancer. Configure listener rules to forward requests to the appropriate AWS Lambda functions

w.y: Both API Gateway and Lambda are serverless and scale automatically over HTTPS. REST APIs support the AWS integration type, so they can call DynamoDB actions directly with mapping templates. HTTP APIs support AWS service integrations only for a fixed set of subtypes (SQS, Kinesis, EventBridge, Step Functions, AppConfig) and exclude DynamoDB, so they need Lambda in front of the table.

o.A: Correct: a REST API's AWS integration can call DynamoDB actions such as GetItem or Query directly.
o.B: HTTP API first-class AWS service integrations don't include DynamoDB.
o.C: Correct: an HTTP API with Lambda proxy integrations reading from DynamoDB is serverless and scales automatically.
o.D: Global Accelerator routes to ALB, NLB, EC2 or Elastic IP endpoints; it has no Lambda@Edge integration, which is CloudFront-only.
o.E: NLBs work at layer 4 and can't target Lambda functions, and listener rules are an ALB feature.

s: Integration subtype reference - Amazon API Gateway (HTTP APIs)
Choose between REST APIs and HTTP APIs - Amazon API Gateway
Choose an API Gateway API integration type
